scope: Original RX-only six features and actual six-stage detect-only TC integer inference; no bidirectional-model retraining or prevention

models.primary: Unchanged src/mlp_params.bpf.h, Q16 [6,32,32,2], original float checkpoint unavailable
models.paired_control: Existing real .output/evaluation/m3-train/float-model.json and quantized-model.json with validated frozen split; not the paper/original checkpoint
models.synthetic_edges: Explicit separate private test models only for near-zero weights/ties/overflow boundaries; never overwrite original assets

trigger: Every matching-source RX FIN or RST after including that packet; not egress, full-biflow shutdown or only the first FIN
lifecycle_difference: New immutable flow generations intentionally prevent original tuple accumulation across reused connections
vector_selection: 512 deterministic labeled rows including both binary labels; use validated saved held-out membership for the paired model; add signed-int64, normalization branch, near-zero, tie and wrap boundaries
floating_point_policy: Report real paired float/quantized metrics and disagreements, not equality of floating and integer logits; never invent/dequantize the missing original float checkpoint
required_live_checks: Actual primary TC hooks attach and process ordinary bidirectional TCP
Frozen RX features exactly match independent headers and actual lock-observed kernel clock reductions
Egress/bidirectional statistics never silently replace the model RX vector
Repeated FIN/RST triggers get independent {flow_id,ordinal} jobs
Eight simultaneous connections and repeated lifetimes do not share mutable stage scratch
Both numeric predicted classes are exercised on real kernel vectors
Uninitialized model slot produces no prediction and an observable reason
Missing tail-call stage produces an observable failure, no partial label, restored skb control buffer and no packet blocking
All five skb control-buffer words restored on success and failure
Full model identity/quantization and actual parameter-map readback match
All owned tail-call slots cleared safely before close; every new owned program/map disappears
Existing Flow/Probe runtime and resource-ownership regressions remain valid
claim_limits: Original static-weight accuracy remains diagnostic because training overlap is unknown
Dataset provenance, feature units and binary-label semantics remain unverified
No wire timing, throughput, latency, production-readiness or paper-reproduction claim
failure_policy: Retain raw failures, finish all reachable fixes within Stage05, do not advance to collector/UI until actual gate PASS
